### Data Preparation

```{r setup, echo=TRUE, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# load data
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thomasthinks/college-roi-data/refs/heads/main/best-value-colleges-by-state.csv"
df <- read_csv(url)
df <- df |>
  mutate(control = factor(control,
                          levels = c("public", "private-nonprofit", "private-forprofit")))

```

```{r}
head(df)
```

### Research question

Of the top-ranking colleges from each state in the United States, is there a relationship between the type of institution, whether public, private non-profit or private profit, and the 30-year net present value (NPV) of attendance in the state?

The results obtained are only from top-ranking institutions since the data only gives details of the top-ranking colleges in each state.

### Cases

**What are the cases, and how many are there?**

Each case is one institution listed in a state's top-value ranking (up to 15 per state). There are 607 cases across 50 states.
